## What changes?

Describe the problem, the resulting behavior, and any linked issue.

## Validation

List the commands you ran and their results. For device-facing changes, distinguish simulated tests from physical device observations and include the device/firmware tested, if any.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and includes relevant tests or an explanation of why tests are unnecessary.
- [ ] Documentation reflects any changes to controls, protocol behavior, or contributor/release steps.
- [ ] Logs, fixtures, and attachments contain no authentication keys or personal device identifiers.
- [ ] No vendor binaries, decompiled code, or generated build outputs are included.

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/igorgarbuz/earstudio-mac/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) for build and contribution instructions.
